intended_object: This is an internal piece of the library's Navier–Stokes construction. It packages assembly data for each label of a cycle state by applying `rebaseAssembly` to the stage assembly and its gap. I inferred this from the docstring and the name.
explanation: The definition only bundles data the library needs for its own proof. It combines library-specific constructions (`ActualParticularStageControls.assembly`, `gap`, `BaseChartJets.cellBand` and `rebaseAssembly`) into an `AssemblyData` value. The docstring just restates the body. The literature has no standard object called "native assembly", so there is nothing to compare it to for faithfulness or generality.
